profile.visual_desc: Muscular human in a red-brown tunic with a prominent blue shoulder scarf and matching waist sash. Features grey trousers, dark leg wraps, and brown hair secured by a blue headband.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Stoic male profile facing left with a sharp jawline and determined eyes. Thick brown hair is partially covered by a wide blue headband.
profile.weapon_desc: Single-handed iron hatchet held in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left; wide crouched stance with the hatchet held near the right shoulder.
profile.step2_windup: Shifts weight forward while raising the hatchet high above the head to maximum reach.
profile.step3_impact: Forceful downward chop toward the top-left, generating a large, fan-shaped golden energy flash that expands outward.
profile.step4_finish: Follow-through pose with hatchet lowered; lingering yellow energy sparks dissipate as the unit recovers its stance.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: The triangular golden energy blast in Frame 4 correctly originates from the axe head and extends along the diagonal downward swing path toward the upper-left.

evaluation.diagnosis: The sequence demonstrates adequate mechanical fidelity to the source. Motion curves and VFX placement align with established parameters, ensuring a coherent transition from windup to recovery.
